summary: A proposed 3-story-plus-basement laboratory building at 700 Indiana St in Dogpatch, replacing an existing one-story building. SF YIMBY (February 2025) names Dewey Land Company and MBC BioLabs as responsible for the application; no source read says a lease has been signed. The SF Planning Commission approved the project in June 2024. The Board of Supervisors rejected a neighborhood appeal of its CEQA exemption in September 2024, which affirmed the exemption only: Potrero View (November 2024) reported a separate Board of Appeals hearing on whether the project can proceed, and its outcome was not found. No building permit had been issued as of September 2026.

milestones.text: SF Planning Commission approves the project (Case No. 2023-001074ENX, Motion No. 21576).

SF Board of Supervisors approves Motion No. M24-089 (File No. 240778) 9-1, affirming the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption and rejecting a neighborhood appeal of the exemption (Board of Supervisors File No. 240777); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote and Supervisor Peskin was excused. The Board's minutes of September 24, 2024 also record an earlier 8-2 vote on the same file: Supervisor Walton's motion to table M24-089 failed, 2 ayes (Ronen, Walton) to 8 noes.

open_questions: Two different named appeal bodies appear in sources on this project: the Board of Supervisors (which heard and rejected the CEQA exemption appeal, resolved 2024-09-24, the event recorded above) and a separate Board of Appeals item (Appeal No. 24-040, continued to a Nov 13, 2024 hearing) whose subject and outcome could not be confirmed -- not established here whether it is the same matter under a different docket or a genuinely separate appeal.
No construction start date or building permit has been found as of 2026-09-28; status is recorded as planned rather than under_construction pending better evidence.

The gross square footage is given as 70,650 (Board of Supervisors agenda, September 24, 2024) and as 72,349 (CEQA Notice of Exemption and Motion M24-089; SF YIMBY, February 2025, says around 72,350); both are kept in facts rather than resolved to one number. The height figures agree once rooftop equipment is counted (48 ft north side, 54 ft with equipment).
The $40,000,000 estimated construction cost is from secondary reporting only, not independently confirmed against a primary Planning or permit document.

Tenant: SF YIMBY (February 2025) names MBC BioLabs with Dewey Land Company as responsible for the application; no source read states that a lease has been signed. MBC BioLabs' flagship campus is at 953 Indiana St, which SF YIMBY calls close to the site.

Gross square footage: the Board of Supervisors agenda for the September 24, 2024 hearing (File No. 240777) says "construct a new 70,650 gross square foot, three-story, 48-foot tall non-life science laboratory building"; the CEQA Notice of Exemption and Motion M24-089 say "72,349 gross square feet of laboratory use", and SF YIMBY (February 2025) says "around 72,350 square feet". The sources disagree by about 1,700 sq ft. The building would replace an existing approximately 15,068 sq ft one-story building on a 0.71-acre (31,090 sq ft) lot.

Height: the CEQA Notice of Exemption and Motion M24-089 give 48 ft on the north side and 33 ft on the south side, or 54 ft and 39 ft including rooftop mechanical equipment and elevator penthouse. SF YIMBY (February 2025) calls it "The 54-foot tall structure", the north side's height with equipment; the Board of Supervisors agenda says "48-foot tall".

No source dated within the last 12 months describes this project. The newest are SF YIMBY (February 2, 2025) and the CEQA notice (January 24, 2025). On October 13, 2026 the City's building-permit dataset showed no permit for new construction at 700 Indiana St (the latest permit listed there is a 2012 sign permit), and the outcome of the Board of Appeals matter is still not found.
